title: Deterministic automated test floor bootstrap and GitHub Actions proof
mission: Bootstrap a repository-owned fail-closed automated test floor from existing static contracts, expose one canonical command for developers and CI, prove it in GitHub Actions with a healthy pass and a representative negative canary, then stop at validated testing without merge/release/deploy authority.
safeParallelWork: Unrelated Pi WSL bootstrap PR work
Domain path-filtered workflow ownership unchanged except foundation registration
forbiddenScope: secrets, credentials, or protected runtime mutation
claiming live/runtime proof from static floor PASS
cron/schedule AFK spend without explicit operator schedule preference
reviving historical git-history repository-floor probe semantics under the same name
expectedArtifacts: canonical PowerShell floor command and receipt
provider proof on exact candidate SHA

tasks.title: Create fail-closed floor manifest and canonical runner
inputs: Existing tests/*.py script and unittest seams
acceptanceCriteria: Required gates declare python-script, python-unittest, or pwsh-file
Zero required gates or zero unittest cases fail closed

tasks.title: Wire GitHub Actions and meta contracts
acceptanceCriteria: push, pull_request, and workflow_dispatch triggers exist
No secrets and no schedule cron for this bootstrap
Meta tests prove healthy fail-closed negative canary locally
evidence: workflow triggers verified by meta contracts

tasks.title: Prove provider green and negative canary on exact head
inputs: PR or push to GitHub Actions
acceptanceCriteria: Exact candidate SHA recorded in workflow logs/receipt
Controlled defect fails the floor for the right reason then is removed
Final head provider PASS without leaving the canary

tasks.title: Second-pass falsification and handoff boundary
acceptanceCriteria: Concrete false-green or bypass gaps repaired or explicitly accepted with evidence

proof.ceiling: GitHub Actions provider-runtime proof of the static automated test floor on an exact candidate SHA, including one restored negative canary. Not runtime, live-target, merge, release, or deployment proof.

handoff.nextOwner: P113 Risk-Driven Test Floor Evolution Executor after bootstrap fixed point
handoff.promotionOwner: P105 only when automated push/merge/release/deploy is explicitly desired
handoff.feedbackOwner: P115 when CI/review/runtime signals identify actionable gaps beyond bootstrap
